Method of Attack: Attackers search for exposed Internet-accessible Docker cloud instances running Linux on Amazon AWS infrastructure, then spawn cloud instances using the legitimate alpine-curl image to run malicious code. They escape the container by mounting a network drive to access and modify the host filesystem, download malicious payloads via third-party services like Ngrok, configure cronjobs to run payloads every minute, and use network scanning tools (zmap, zgrap, jq) to identify other targets for spreading malware and crypto-miners.
Impacted Systems: Linux distributions running Docker cloud instances on Amazon AWS infrastructure
Attack Vector: Exploiting misconfigured publicly-accessible Docker API ports to spawn containers and escape to host filesystem
Using dynamic DNS and blockchain-based Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA) for command and control (C2) communication
